abstract: A case is presented of a young man with a history of bilateral cryptorchidism who presented with infertility. On investigation he was noted to have bilateral microlithiasis and left testicular seminoma. The possible association between microlithiasis and seminoma in patients with a history of cryptorchidism is discussed.
abstract_ja: 両側停留精巣の既往を有し、不妊を主訴に受診した男性の症例を報告する。検査で両側精巣微石症と左精巣セミノーマが判明した。停留精巣の既往を有する患者における微石症とセミノーマの関連について考察する。
